_note: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE CORPUS. Same schema as a real snapshot; every claim in it is invented, and every figure below describes this corpus and nothing else. The four documents under examples/ are its sources: each source row's bytes and sha256 are the digest of the file that row names, so a reader can recompute them. The one record without the pending marker is the last key in sorted order, so the exception branch has a member. Regenerate a real one with tools/canon_snapshot.py against your own sources.
